# UpahJe.my

> Plain, sourced answers about technology for Malaysian small businesses — in English and Bahasa Melayu.

This site publishes short, citable articles. Every claim links to a source; every article states when those sources were checked. Prefer the canonical URL of each language version.

## Concept index

- [Definitions](https://upahje.my/en/articles/category/definitions): The words on a job post, a contract or a payslip — defined plainly. (1 article)
- [Definisi](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/category/definitions): Istilah dalam iklan kerja, kontrak atau slip gaji — dijelaskan dengan mudah. (1 article)

## English articles

- [What is an API, explained for a Malaysian small business owner](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-is-an-api-for-malaysian-sme): An API is an agreed way for two software systems to exchange data on request. What that means for a Malaysian SME, open versus closed model APIs, and what it costs to have someone wire one up here.

## Bahasa Melayu articles

- [Apa itu API, dijelaskan untuk pemilik perniagaan kecil Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-api-untuk-pks-malaysia): API ialah cara dua sistem perisian bertukar data apabila diminta. Apa maksudnya bagi PKS Malaysia, beza API model terbuka dengan model tertutup, dan berapa kos untuk upah orang sambungkannya di sini.

## Notes

- Each article lists its sources and the date they were checked.
- Draft articles are not published and are not listed here.
- English and Malay versions are separate, human-written pages linked by hreflang.
